STUDENT DATA PRIVACY AGREEMENT

This Student Data Privacy Agreement is between Lakeshore Unified School District ("District") and Brightpath Learning, Inc. ("Provider").

1. Purpose. Provider will supply its online reading platform to the District and will receive student data to do so.

2. Ownership. Student data remains the property of and under the control of the District.

3. Use. Provider will use student data only to provide the platform and will not use it for targeted advertising.

4. Security. Provider will maintain reasonable safeguards and will notify the District of any unauthorized disclosure.

5. Deletion. Provider will delete student data when the District asks or the contract ends.
